"""待办清单 CLI。"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

DATA_FILE = Path("todos.json")

def load_todos() -> list[dict]:
    """读取任务列表。"""
    if DATA_FILE.exists():
        return json.loads(DATA_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return []

def save_todos(todos: list[dict]) -> None:
    """保存任务列表。"""
    DATA_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(todos, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def main() -> None:
    """解析命令行并分发。"""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="todo")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    add = sub.add_parser("add"); add.add_argument("text")
    sub.add_parser("list")
    # TODO: 实现 add/list/done/remove
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""销售数据报表生成。"""
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

def analyze(csv_path: str, out_dir: str = "reports") -> dict:
    """读取销售数据并生成报表。"""
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path, encoding="utf-8")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["region"])
    df["amount"] = pd.to_numeric(df["amount"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    by_region = df.groupby("region")["amount"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
    Path(out_dir).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    by_region.to_csv(Path(out_dir) / "by_region.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"total": float(df["amount"].sum()), "regions": len(by_region)}

def main() -> None:
    """入口。"""
    print(analyze("sales.csv"))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""AI 学习助手：为代码提供解释与建议。"""
import os
import httpx

SYSTEM = "你是一名严谨的 Python 助教，解释代码并给出改进建议，代码用 markdown 代码块。"

def review_code(code: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-mini") -> str:
    """调用大模型评审代码。"""
    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        return "未配置 OPENAI_API_KEY，使用本地规则提示"
    base = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM},
        {"role": "user", "content": f"请评审以下代码：\n```python\n{code}\n```"},
    ]
    try:
        resp = httpx.post(
            f"{base}/chat/completions",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
            json={"model": model, "messages": messages, "temperature": 0.2},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    except (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError) as exc:
        return f"AI 服务暂不可用：{exc}"

def main() -> None:
    """入口。"""
    sample = "def f(l):\n    return [i for i in l if i % 2 == 0]\n"
    print(review_code(sample))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
